title: NFL has been "monitoring developments" in Tyreek Hill case

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL has been "monitoring developments" in Tyreek Hill case
sources.description: On Tuesday, a jury entered a mixed verdict in the civil lawsuit filed against free-agent receiver Tyreek Hill by his former wife, Keeta Vaccaro.
